name: Cheese Bank LP oracle priced from spot pair reserves
summary: CheesePriceOracle valued the CHEESE/WETH Uniswap V2 LP token from the pair's spot WETH balance, without the TWAP its other assets used, and refresh() was permissionless. The attacker swapped flash-loaned ETH into the pair, refreshed the inflated LP price, and borrowed the USDC, USDT and DAI markets' cash against LP collateral.
notes: The oracle is immutable, but the Comptroller (via its timelock) switched its oracle pointer to it after deployment; that switch is when the markets began pricing LP collateral with this code, so it is the reset.
Loss is the cash of the three stablecoin markets at DefiLlama prices. The LP collateral the attacker left behind is not subtracted (rule 14).
